title: Change Report
description: Per-change classification, meaning-preservation result, and reader-effort rationale for a revision.

original_ref.description: Identifier of the version before the change.

revised_ref.description: Identifier of the version after the change.

principle.description: The named reader-effort or soundness principle invoked.

rationale.description: The reader effect that justifies the change, not taste.

dropped_qualifications.description: Every hedge, scope word, or condition removed, each with its original site.

meaning_preserved.description: Whether propositional meaning survived every change.

role_reference_integrity.description: True when no referent is orphaned and no agent/patient role is inverted.

technical_precision_held.description: True when technical terms kept their exact sense.

fidelity_confidence.description: Confidence that meaning was preserved across the changes.

decision_record.description: The visible evidence trail: which methodology sections were consulted and which checks ran. Cites methodology/*.md by file and section only, never a book title, author name, or locator.

methodology_loaded.description: methodology/<file>.md#<section> references, one per rule actually applied.

rules_set_aside.description: Each entry names the lawful exception used.

validation_warnings.description: Warnings raised by the revision comparison.
